title: Prospective surface-state comparison of existing Layer-ROM representations against a qualified numerical uncertainty envelope
execution_precondition: C6N1 must close C6N1_R2048_T32_REFERENCE_UNCERTAINTY_QUALIFIED before any C6N2 candidate response is generated.

workload.top_forcing: Exactly C6M2/C6N1 exposed Reference-design surface-flux histories.

reference_and_uncertainty.uncertainty: Metric- and material-specific U_combined from C6N1 = U_space + U_time.
interpretation: Candidate metric <= U_combined: NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_FROM_REFERENCE for that metric.
Candidate metric > U_combined: NUMERICALLY_RESOLVED_DIFFERENCE for that metric.
U_combined is numerical Reference uncertainty, not a hydrological application tolerance.

diagnostics: time of maximum absolute 0-20 storage error

classification.per_metric: NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_FROM_REFERENCE iff candidate RMSE <= material-specific C6N1 U_combined for that metric.
classification.per_view: NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_VIEW iff every metric in the declared view is numerically unresolved.
classification.otherwise: RESOLVED_DIFFERENCE_VIEW; report each metric and exceedance ratio candidate/U_combined without converting it to an application pass/fail.
classification.minimum_dimension: For each material and each view, report the minimum member of the frozen lower-zone ladder, if any, that is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_VIEW.
classification.placement: Compare R4, P4_TOP_LOWER, U4 and R8/U8 componentwise; no scalar winner.

hypotheses.H_TOP_PLACEMENT_R4: P4_TOP_LOWER is componentwise no worse than R4 on SURFACE_20 and ROOT_ZONE_40.
hypotheses.H_UNIFORM_VS_FOCUSED_R4: Report R4/P4/U4 componentwise without scalar ranking.
hypotheses.H_R8_VS_U8: Report R8/U8 componentwise on all views.
hypotheses.H_PURPOSE_DIMENSION_SEPARATION: Minimum numerically-unresolved dimension may differ among SURFACE_20, ROOT_ZONE_40, UPPER_ZONE_80 and PROFILE_STATE.
hypotheses.H_MATERIAL_TRANSFER: Report B01 and B14 separately; no material-invariant minimum is presumed.

decision_logic.C6N2_NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_REDUCED_FRON: At least one reduced representation is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_VIEW on at least one declared view.
decision_logic.C6N2_RESOLVED_REDUCED_DIFFERENCES_ONLY: Every reduced representation has at least one resolved metric in every declared view.
decision_logic.C6N2_REFERENCE_PRECONDITION_FAILED: C6N1 is not qualified; no candidate execution.

interpretation_boundary: A numerically unresolved candidate cannot be distinguished from the numerical Reference at the admitted discretization uncertainty for that metric/view.
A numerically resolved candidate is not automatically hydrologically unacceptable; application tolerance remains independently governed.
No ET/root-uptake, drainage/recharge, groundwater or drought prediction claim follows from this prescribed-bottom-flux surface-state workload.
stop_rules: No candidate execution unless C6N1 qualifies.
Do not change partitions, dt, closure, histories, metrics or uncertainty classification after C6N1 result.
Do not reinterpret U_combined as an application tolerance.
No new top-focused partition after response.
